CustomField.description: Lookup filter restricts the picker to Gift Designations where IsActive = True. Filter is deployed as Optional (not Required) so users can uncheck the "Filter by:" toggle in the lookup dialog to see all designations. Override is allowed for two reasons: (1) back-dated corrections to commitments whose original designation has since been retired, and (2) uncertainty about upstream integrations — an inbound integration may legitimately need to attach a default designation to a commitment that references a designation not currently active. Change to Required only if your organization has full control over the sources of commitment data and no back-dating scenarios.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: By default this picker only shows active Gift Designations. If you need to attach this record to a retired designation (for example, to correct a back-dated commitment or to match an inbound integration), uncheck the "Filter by:" checkbox at the top of the lookup dialog to see all designations.
